although: Although it was difficult, we kept trying.
because: We stayed inside because it was raining.
however: It looked simple. However, it took practice.
therefore: The road was closed. Therefore, we took another route.

sense_cautions.cap: A spending limit and an item of clothing are different senses; choose the sense from context.
sense_cautions.center: A location and a basketball position are different senses; centre is an accepted spelling variant.
sense_cautions.pick up: Possible meanings include collect, learn informally and improve; do not assign one gloss to every occurrence.
sense_cautions.present: Check part of speech and meaning before selecting pronunciation.
sense_cautions.record: Noun and verb stress may differ; derive pronunciation from the sentence.
sense_cautions.bank: A financial institution and the side of a river are different senses.
